input_messages.content: Hey, I just got off my weekly phone call with Mom. Man, she can really talk.
How is she doing? Did she have any advice for your apartment hunting tomorrow afternoon with Liwei?
Oh yeah, definitely. She suggested we should only look at places with south-facing windows during the apartment hunting. She's very particular about the sunlight.
Classic mom advice! South-facing windows do get the best light. Did she have any other demands?

Well, she also spent ten minutes complaining about her neighbor's loud parrot while we were discussing the apartment hunting. I had to steer the conversation back. I told her I need to make sure I wear comfortable sneakers for the apartment hunting since we'll be walking around so much tomorrow.
Good call on the sneakers, especially since you're taking the whole afternoon off to look around. Did you manage to reassure her about the apartments?
Yeah, I did. I promised Mom I would send her a video tour of every single place we view during the apartment hunting. That finally gave her some peace of mind.
That's a solid promise. I'll remind you to record those videos tomorrow so you can keep her in the loop!
Hey, I just finished syncing with Boss Zhang about the Shenzhen trip.
Nice! How did the sync go? Any roadblocks?
No roadblocks at all. He officially approved the 5000 RMB travel budget for the Shenzhen trip today.
Awesome, that's a relief. It's good to have that locked in before the Double Eleven prep gets too crazy.
For sure. He was actually super relaxed. He even asked if I like eating Cantonese dim sum, since I'm going on the Shenzhen trip.
Haha, that's cool of him! You should definitely try to grab some while you're down there.

I will if I have time. We also chatted about how humid the weather will likely be during the Shenzhen trip, so I'm not looking forward to the sweating. Oh, by the way, I need to buy a new carry-on suitcase for the Shenzhen trip soon.
I hear you on the humidity! I'll make a note to remind you to shop for that new carry-on suitcase before you leave.

That's super convenient! A good roast goose sounds like the perfect way to unwind after a long day. Are you feeling good about the trip overall?

Good call on checking the suit! Looking sharp is half the battle. You've got that presentation in the bag, though. How's the rest of the packing going?
Almost done. Liwei was just asking if I managed to book a window seat for the flight for the Shenzhen trip. I did, thankfully, so I can zone out a bit on the way there.

How did it go? Did the budget hold up?

Yeah, add a joke that the airline food during the Shenzhen trip is probably going to be terrible as always.
Sent! He'll probably agree with you on that. Need me to look up any food spots near your gate?
Nah, I'll just grab a coffee. Oh, Jiange just replied asking if I packed my favorite blue shirt for the Shenzhen trip. Tell him yes, it's in the suitcase.
Done. I let him know the lucky blue shirt made the cut. Ready to head to the gate soon?
